label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y si minjá de sartén tu ofrenda, sólet en el aceite será hecha.
spanish: Y si oblación de sartén tu ofrenda, harina fina en el aceite será hecha.
grammarChanges: Replaced transliteration 'minjá' with Spanish 'oblación' for H4503 (noun common feminine singular construct).
Replaced transliteration 'sólet' with Spanish 'harina fina' for H5560 (noun common feminine singular absolute).
readerNote: Minjá is rendered oblación, not ofrenda, so it stays distinct from קרבן/tu ofrenda in the same verse.
